# Centre de culture numérique (CCN) - Université de Strasbourg

> CCN is Université de Strasbourg's digital culture center offering training, workshops, and innovation labs to build digital literacy and support technology transformation across the university and broader community.

The Centre de culture numérique (CCN) serves as a hub for digital literacy, professional development, and technology innovation at Université de Strasbourg. It combines hands-on training programs, research through its Digital Observatory, and collaborative spaces like the Lab numérique to foster digital skills and cultural awareness.
